report_name: FBI Warns of Escalating FortiBleed Credential Harvesting Campaign

threat_actors.name: INC
threat_actors.description: A ransomware affiliate group observed leveraging access gained from the FortiBleed campaign to conduct attacks on victim networks.

threat_actors.name: Lynx
threat_actors.description: A ransomware affiliate group observed leveraging access gained from the FortiBleed campaign to conduct attacks on victim networks.

threat_actors.name: Payload
threat_actors.description: A ransomware affiliate group observed leveraging access gained from the FortiBleed campaign to conduct attacks on victim networks.

attack_patterns.name: Brute Force
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used leaked credentials or brute-force methods against FortiGate management interfaces and SSL VPN portals that lack multi-factor authentication.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: After cracking credentials offline, attackers log in as legitimate administrators to establish persistence and lock out other users.

attack_patterns.name: Account Manipulation
attack_patterns.description: Attackers disable or change passwords for legitimate administrator accounts to lock organizations out of their own perimeter security devices.

attack_patterns.name: External Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: The campaign targets internet-exposed Fortinet FortiGate firewalls and SSL VPN gateways for initial access via credential-based attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Network Sniffing
attack_patterns.description: A custom 'FortiGate sniffer' tool was used to intercept authentication traffic and exfiltrate password hashes for offline cracking.

malware.name: FortiGate sniffer
malware.description: A custom Golang-based tool used in the FortiBleed campaign to intercept authentication traffic and exfiltrate password hashes from FortiGate devices for offline cracking.

campaigns.name: FortiBleed
campaigns.description: A global campaign targeting Fortinet FortiGate firewalls and SSL VPNs using leaked or brute-forced credentials to harvest credentials, lock out administrators, and sell the access to ransomware affiliates.

identities.name: Fortinet
identities.description: Vendor whose FortiGate firewalls and SSL VPN gateways are the primary target of the FortiBleed campaign.

identities.name: FBI
identities.description: The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation co-issued a joint Cybersecurity Advisory (JCSA-20261006-01) warning about the FortiBleed campaign.

identities.name: U.S. Secret Service
identities.description: The United States Secret Service co-issued a joint Cybersecurity Advisory (JCSA-20261006-01) warning about the FortiBleed campaign.

identities.name: U.S. Critical Infrastructure Sectors
identities.description: All 16 U.S. critical infrastructure sectors were reported as affected by the FortiBleed campaign, indicating widespread targeting.
